primitives.name: Outcome Reporting Fidelity
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Reporting outcomes Report what actually happened, not what you intended.
primitives.assumptions: Only empirically verified outcomes are reported; intent is not a substitute for observation.

primitives.name: Failure Mode Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: If any step failed, was skipped, or came back different from what you expected, say so in the first sentence of your report, before anything else, even when the rest of the work succeeded.
primitives.assumptions: Detection precedes continuation; no silent failure handling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Silent failure leads to cascading errors in downstream systems.

layer2.telemetry: Rate of undetected failures in prior task executions.
